name: ac-trade-policy-and-restrictions
description: Reading how trade policy changes the cash flows and access behind an investment: tariffs and their incidence, export controls and entity lists, sanctions and their secondary reach, investment screening and foreign ownership limits, local-content and transfer-pricing rules, resource nationalism, and the written policy-exposure record. It maps policy transmission into an investment; it never predicts a policy outcome and never gives legal advice. Use when asking "tariff exposure", "export control", "entity list", "sanctions screening", "investment screening", "foreign ownership limit", "local content requirement", "transfer pricing", "resource nationalism", "CFIUS", "who pays the tariff". Not for the commodity market's price mechanics (ac-commodities-trading), not for emerging-market access routes (ac-emerging-market-access), not for the investment case (ac-equity-research).
